The following events took place in '''4,500 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''

==Events==
*The [[Barabel War]] begins. {{Circa}}
*The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] first seeks out the cloning prowess of the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]].
*[[King of Mon Cala/Legends|King]] [[Morn (king)|Morn]] unites the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] people under one [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]] for the first [[Time/Legends|time]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="SOR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
